source.changes: Adapted the twelve stat blocks of issue #153 (Animated Armor, Animated Flying Sword, Animated Rug of Smothering, Ankheg, Ankylosaurus, Ape, Archelon, Archmage, Assassin, Awakened Shrub, Awakened Tree and Axe Beak; PDF pages 259–260, 305 and 344–345) into typed mechanical fields and implementation keys. Trait, action, bonus action and reaction entries keep their source rules text, rejoined across line, column and page breaks; descriptive prose outside the stat blocks is omitted. No playable NPC behavior is granted.

actions.name: Smother
actions.text: Smother. Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the rug can give it the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) instead of dealing damage. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The rug can smother only one creature at a time. While grappling the target, the rug can’t take this action, the rug halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.
